title: Skip Bin, Trailer or Rubbish Removal: What to Choose in Brisbane
excerpt: Clearing a property before sale? Here's how skip bins, trailer hire and rubbish removal services compare on cost, convenience and what you can actually dump.
body:
Decluttering before a sale is unglamorous but essential — a cluttered home photographs badly, feels smaller to buyers, and can quietly cost you at auction. In Brisbane, you've got three main options for shifting the junk: hiring a skip bin, renting a trailer, or booking a rubbish removal service. Each suits different situations, and picking the wrong one wastes money.

## The Three Options at a Glance

| Option | Typical Brisbane Cost (2026) | Best For |
|---|---|---|
| Skip bin (2–4 m³) | $280–$450 delivered + collected | Large volume, flexible timing |
| Trailer hire (box trailer) | $80–$130 per day | Light loads, DIY-friendly |
| Rubbish removal service | $200–$600+ depending on load | Mixed or heavy items, no effort |

Prices vary by suburb, access, and what you're dumping. These are realistic mid-range figures — get three quotes before committing.

## Skip Bin Hire: Good for Volume, Awkward in Tight Spots

A skip bin dropped on your driveway or street is the classic declutter tool for a reason. You fill it at your own pace over several days, which suits a staged cleanout before listing.

**Advantages:**
- Pay once, fill over time (typically 3–7 day hire period)
- Good value for large quantities of general waste
- Many suppliers in Brisbane will take garden waste, timber, and mixed household rubbish

**Watch out for:**
- Brisbane City Council requires a permit if the bin sits on a public road — your supplier usually organises this, but confirm it and factor in a permit fee ($50–$100 is common)
- Steep driveways, narrow access, or no off-street parking can rule out a skip entirely
- Minimum hire periods mean short jobs can feel expensive

### What Cannot Go in a Skip Bin

This catches people out. Standard skip bins across Brisbane will refuse:

- **Asbestos** (requires a licensed asbestos removalist and separate licensed disposal)
- **Mattresses** (most suppliers charge a surcharge of $30–$60 each, or won't take them at all)
- **Tyres** — banned from general landfill in Queensland
- **Liquid waste**, oils, paints, and chemicals
- **Gas bottles and cylinders**
- **E-waste** (TVs, computers, monitors) — Queensland has a separate e-waste recycling scheme; check your local transfer station
- **Fridges and air conditioners** containing refrigerant gas

If your cleanout includes any of these, budget for separate disposal or a rubbish removal company that specialises in them.

## Trailer Hire: Cheapest If You Do the Work

A box trailer from a hire company or hardware store runs $80–$130 per day in Brisbane. You load it, tow it to a transfer station, pay the gate fee (typically $20–$80 depending on weight and what you're dropping off at Brisbane City Council facilities), and return the trailer.

This works well if:
- You have a tow vehicle and tow bar already fitted
- Your load is manageable — a few pieces of furniture, garden rubbish, general clutter
- You can do it in one or two trips in a single day

It falls apart quickly if you underestimate volume, don't have a tow vehicle, or if the load includes heavy items like old concrete, soil, or bricks. Transfer stations also have their own restricted items list that largely mirrors the skip bin restrictions above.

## Rubbish Removal Services: Easiest, But Check What You're Paying For

Companies like Brisbane-based removalists and national operators send a truck and two crew members, load everything themselves, and drive away. You pay by the cubic metre or by the truck fraction.

This is the right call when:
- You're time-poor and want the job done in a morning
- You have heavy or awkward items — old sofas, appliances, garden waste mixed with furniture
- You're elderly or don't have people to help lift
- The mix of waste types makes a DIY skip complicated

Ask any operator directly what they accept before booking. Reputable companies will recycle or donate usable items rather than sending everything to landfill — this matters if you want to responsibly dispose of furniture a charity could use.

## Which to Choose When Selling in Brisbane

- **Lots of rubbish, flexible timeline, easy access:** Skip bin.
- **Small load, you can tow, one day available:** Trailer hire.
- **Mixed or heavy items, no time, tricky access:** Rubbish removal service.
- **Asbestos present in the property:** Neither — engage a licensed removalist. This is non-negotiable and legally required in Queensland.

## Actionable Takeaway

Before you book anything, do a walk-through and list every item that needs to go. Separate restricted items (mattresses, e-waste, chemicals, anything that could be asbestos-containing material) and price their disposal independently. Then get at least two quotes for the main bulk — skip bin companies and rubbish removal operators both price by volume, so knowing your approximate cubic metreage gives you a meaningful basis for comparison. A cleanout done properly before your first open home is one of the cheapest ways to make your property show better.
